text:
eval-bot: :warning: Nightly eval alert — 6/12 prompt cohorts failed for m-2beta-int4 on nightly-eval v2. Auto severity: MED. Creating triage thread. sample cohort: cohort-17. link: https://evals.internal/nightly/2177777777

sana: on it — can someone paste the failing cohorts? any overlap with yesterday's blip?

devin: failing cohorts: qa-instruct, multi-turn-chat, math-fewshot, code-gen-simple, summarization-long, persona-consistency

maya: grabbing a few raw generations now. here's one bad sample from summarization-long:
```
Prompt: Summarize the following court ruling in plain english...
Model(m-2beta-int4): "The party who did the thing did not do the thing because the precedent established the opposite which therefore means the motion denied."
Expected: clear 3-4 sentence summary with disposition and rationale.
```

liam: that output looks like collapse/shortcutting not just token noise. any recent quant changes pushed to m-2beta-int4?

devin: pushed quant config change (clip-range tweak) in last deploy at 2177700000, also updated kernel pick for fused-attn. both could affect int4 behaviour

jonathan: quick sanity check: float32 baseline (m-2beta) run small-cohort-17 50 samples -> passes. so this is likely quantization-specific.

sana: good — makes scope smaller. can someone run a 50-sample focused eval with logging of logits and topk diff between float32 vs int4? command I usually use:
```bash
python -m evals.run --model m-2beta-int4 --cohort cohort-17 --limit 50 --log-topk 5 --save-diffs /tmp/int4-diffs.json
python -m evals.run --model m-2beta --cohort cohort-17 --limit 50 --log-topk 5 --save-diffs /tmp/fp32-diffs.json
```

alejandra: kicking off int4 run now (job id: job-2177778001). attaching stderr if it crashes.

maya: note: some code-gen-simple failures show truncated code with repeated function names — sounds like kv-cache misalignment? not sure

liam: are we seeing any kv-cache-related commits in the window? I recall a KVCACHE eviction change around 2177680000 but that was for long-context perf

jonathan: cross-checking commit history — KVCACHE eviction patch only on dedicated runtime for longcontext branch; integer quant path did get small KV reorder for efficient packing (2177695000). could be related

devin: initial triage plan:
- owner: @sana (lead), @devin (backup)
- run float32 vs int4 diffs (in progress)
- run int8-lite variant if available to see continuum
- produce 20 paired samples for human check and attach to pager
- if diffs show logits divergence > 4.0 median across steps -> escalate severity to HIGH and block rollout

sana: ack. I'll wait for diff outputs. if int8 passes and int4 fails -> likely quant rounding/clip-range. if both fail -> regression in model weights or tokenizer

alejandra: int4 job finished: summary -> 38/50 bad per our success criteria; saved diffs at s3://eval-diffs/2177778001-int4.json

maya: uploading 20 paired samples to thread: https://drive.internal/triage/2177777777/samples.zip

devin: ran fp32 compare locally — 3/50 marginal fails, 47/50 good. comparing topk diffs now. early stat: median logit delta at generation start = 5.2, later steps = 2.1

liam: that's a big delta at start. could be embedding quantization mismatch. did the embedding table quantization get changed?

jonathan: embeddings were reprofiled (2177690000) for faster memory layout. that could change quant scales if not recomputed consistently across steps

sana: next steps for today:
- run int8-lite and a rebuild of int4 with prior clip-range (rollback) to see if behavior reverts (devin)
- add per-token perplexity and token-level disagreement heatmap (maya)
- prepare short writeup for eng-oncall if we escalate (alejandra)

devin: starting int8 run now (job-2177778200) and a rollback int4 build to previous clip-range (job-2177778250)

sana: setting owner and ETA: owner=sana, ETA first pass diffs 30m, full triage doc by EOD. tagging @eng-oncall if we need to escalate :rotating_light:
eval-bot: Reaction recorded: :eyes:  (alert acknowledged)

alejandra: logging action items in the triage board: https://kanban.internal/triage/2177 — will update with final verdict

maya: if rollback fixes it we should hold new int4 on dedicated and hosted pools. won't push new quant until we confirm

devin: initial verdict will be posted in-thread once int8 and rollback runs complete.

sana: thanks all — keep updates small and frequent. will open a short postmortem if we hit escalation

jonathan: thumbs up. going to run a mini-repro with seed 123 and attach model inputs/outputs for safety team

alejandra: noted. pinging @security for FYI

sana: update 25m: rollback-int4 build is done, testing 50-sample now (job-2177778350)

devin: int8-lite finished: 4/50 fails (closer to fp32). suggests int4-specific quant aggressiveness

sana: good signal. if rollback-int4 passes we'll mark root cause as quant clip-range change and plan rollback on prod int4. will reconvene after rollback results. :white_check_mark:
